law: every verifier change must keep this corpus green; expectations assert raw Issue codes for any registered process and derive from code thresholds plus the vendor standard each check cites. KNOWN-GAP rows hold proven divergences open: they fail loudly without breaking CI and must be promoted when the fix lands.
semantics_note: Overhang code convention: a face trips when angle_from_up(normal) > 90 + threshold (undersides). Formlabs cites 19 degrees FROM HORIZONTAL (formlabs-design-guide.pdf); sla.py implements 19 from vertical, so the code trips undersides shallower than 71 degrees from horizontal while its citation says 19. Wall thickness = inward ray from face centroids; rays fired from hole/cavity surfaces can travel through material and inflate t_max (see KNOWN-GAP phantom-wall rows). Build volume is checked axis-aligned without trying rotations.

fixtures.note: Sealed hollow squat cylinder (outer r20 h15, cavity r17 h9). Internal ceiling is a true downward concave pocket: cupping positive control. Fully enclosed cavity: trapped-volume positive control for both processes.
350x310x100 exceeds the 300x300x350 FDM envelope under every rotation (sorted dims [100,310,350] vs [300,300,350]). Must always trip.
40mm-tall frustum, 0.5 deg wall draft. Below the 1.0 deg IM/die-cast minimum; must trip.
Same frustum at 1.5 deg draft: above the 1.0 deg minimum by 0.5 deg. Pairs with trap-draft-0p5deg as the precision test for the draft gate.
20x20x40 stem + 60x60x10 cap (unioned). Cap underside annulus is unreachable from +Z: true 3-axis undercut, 5-axis warning.

r30 base + r15 upper, unioned so no internal artifact faces. Every downward-facing region is reachable base bottom or the shoulder faces up: no 3-axis undercut. SHARP_INTERNAL_CORNERS fires at the shoulder and is accepted milling truth (not asserted either way).
16 square pockets = 128 sharp concave edges, over both the >=10 (radii) and >=5 (fillets) count floors. Positive control for the floors.
50x50x2mm flat blank: 2.0mm is a standard gauge inside the 0.5-6mm range. Fully clean.
0.2mm foil below the 0.3 code threshold. Note the message text says 'below 0.5mm min gauge' while the code trips at 0.3: threshold/message mismatch held as finding F11, not a corpus row.
Blind hole dia 4mm depth 44mm: ratio 11 > 10. Feature detector must find the hole; trips on detection.
Plain r30 h60 cylinder: symmetric with rotational surface evidence, L/D 2. Turning must be fully clean.
r10 h220: L/D 11 > 10 deflection limit.
r10 h180: L/D 9, under the limit. Boundary pair with trap-shaft-ld11.
100mm solid cube: V/SA modulus 16.7mm, over both the sand (12) and investment (15) thresholds.
60mm solid cube: modulus 10.0, under both thresholds. Boundary pair with trap-cube-100mm-bulky. The 12-vs-15 divergence between the two casting processes is documented as finding F10.
Solid r10 h100 rod containing a sealed dia 4mm x 100mm channel (two bodies). Core aspect 25:1 > 6: fragile-core trip; the sealed channel is also a trapped volume for AM.
60x60x20 block with a 45 deg pyramidal top: genuinely non-prismatic for wire EDM.
Underside 10 deg above horizontal: below the Formlabs 19 deg-from-level minimum, so it trips under BOTH the citation and the code. Hard boundary anchor.
Underside 80 deg above horizontal (10 from vertical): self-supporting under both readings. Fully clean for SLA and DLP.

F1/F2: solid 10mm cube. CUPPING_RISK fires on any part with >10% downward-facing area - the docstring says 'concave downward-facing pockets' but the code never tests concavity, so every flat-bottomed solid trips it. RESIDUAL_STRESS_RISK fires on any single flat facet group >15% of area with no absolute-size floor, so a 10mm metal cube gets a curl-risk warning. Fixture copied verbatim from trap-corpus v1.2.

F1: cup WITH a compliant 4mm drain hole. Drain relieves peel suction per the Formlabs guidance the check cites; the implementation cannot see drain holes and fires on the exterior base anyway. Copied verbatim from trap-corpus v1.2.

F3: underside 44 deg from vertical = 46 deg from horizontal, self-supporting per the Formlabs 19 deg-from-level citation, but sla.py's 90+19-from-up test trips it. The dlp sub-row is HARD and trips: DLP's own cite says 30 deg from vertical and 44 > 30 - the same file proving one gate's convention is cited right and the other's is not. Copied verbatim from trap-corpus v1.2.
F3: underside 30 deg above horizontal: above the Formlabs 19 deg minimum (should pass, citation-true) but inside the code's effective 71 deg band (trips today).
F4: sorted dims [100,200,350] fit the sorted FDM envelope [300,300,350] when the part is rotated, but the axis-aligned zip trips on X=350>300. Orientation-naive build-volume check.
F4: r40 h300 shaft along X. Lathe envelope is (254,254,533): the 300mm length fits in Z, but the axis-aligned check fails it on X. Same file correctly trips SLA (300 > 210 under any rotation).

F5: uniform 3mm-wall hollow box with a 4mm drain. Measured wall: min 2.99, median 3.0, but max 38.5 with 45% of faces >6mm - rays fired from the drain-hole surface travel radially through the slab and inflate t_max, producing phantom THICK_WALL/NON_UNIFORM_WALLS on a geometrically uniform part.

F5 isolated: plain 5mm plate with one dia 2mm through-hole. Uniform 5mm stock, min ligament 1.5mm; the hole's cylindrical surface faces still produce phantom thick-wall readings. F13: the 2mm hole's 64-section tessellation chords (0.098mm) are 31% of all edges, so SMALL_FEATURES fires on fdm/sls/mjf/ebm/binder_jetting/dmls/slm even though the smallest real feature is a 2mm hole.

F6: one 20x20x12 square pocket = 8 sharp concave edges. die_casting (floor >=5) fires MISSING_FILLETS (hard sub-row, green today); cnc_3axis (floor >=10) stays silent even though a 0.5mm-radius tool cannot cut the corners. The two floors disagree on the same geometry.

F7: ten 5mm ribs + one 0.3mm rib on a 100mm plate. The 0.3mm rib is unprintable at 0.4mm nozzle resolution, but small-edge fraction ~1.4% is under the 5% significance floor, so SMALL_FEATURES stays silent. THIN_WALL still catches it at WARNING (hard sub-row, green today).

F8: dia 8 x 16 blind hole, ratio 2 (DEEP_HOLE absent is hard and green). The flat hole bottom's tessellation edges count as >=10 sharp concave edges, so SHARP_INTERNAL_CORNERS fires on any modeled blind hole - but a drilled hole bottom is a 118 deg conical point, not a sharp corner. F13: an 8mm blind hole's chords (0.3925mm) are under the 0.4 FDM threshold: SMALL_FEATURES fires on a hole no vendor would flag.

F9: U-channel formed from 2mm sheet. check_sheet_gauge reads thickness as the smallest BBOX dimension (28mm), not wall thickness, so a correctly-gauged formed part is flagged TOO_THICK_SHEET. Every formed (non-flat) sheet part trips this.

F12: 60x60x5 plate with r4 edge fillets - a prismatic 2.5D part wire EDM cuts fine. check_prismatic counts FACES not area, so the tessellated fillet strips (256 small triangles) outvote the plate and trip NOT_PRISMATIC. Verdict changes with tessellation, not geometry.
